text: Somehow you get the weapon working, and now you broadcast your ultimate ransom demand to the United Nations: one trillion dollars, or else.
Here is the basic math you forgot. One trillion dollars in crisp one-hundred-dollar bills weighs eleven thousand tons. You cannot casually carry that out of a bank in a sleek black briefcase.

Even stacked neatly on wooden pallets, you would need more than five hundred eighteen-wheel cargo trucks idling outside your volcano just to haul the cash away. And if you demand cryptocurrency instead, every public ledger gets tracked and frozen by exchanges in minutes.

Worse, your high-power broadcast signal just handed away your exact location. At forty-two seconds into your dramatic villain monologue, supersonic fighter jets are already screaming toward your airspace.
You demanded total world domination, and instead you created the worst traffic jam in criminal history while arguing about pallet jacks.
